fact: On 4 May 2021 SAPS told the Portfolio Committee on Police that the ICDMS had been implemented in 998 police stations with 159 still to be covered as the network was upgraded; at those low-network stations cases were registered on the old system, which merged the information into the same database as the ICDMS, and Technology Management Services was engaging SITA on the technical difficulties.
title: SAPS 2021/22 Annual Performance Plan (Administration & Visible Policing); with Deputy Minister
